title: Turn failed prompt-only index trial into Native Semantic Navigation R0

before.state: Prompt-only compatibility was declared, but Fixed Carrier T2 rendered generic navigation categories rather than actual document entry points. A real multimodal trial read BOOT yet failed the index query, requested binary/file decoding and produced unverified mechanical claims.

after.state: Fixed Carrier profile-2 makes T2 an actual bounded semantic superindex, keeps T3 as separate exact/control plane, updates Master Prompt R3 to semantic-first query routing, records the failed trial as a permanent regression, and forbids unverified byte/hash/compression claims.

removed_or_demoted: generic PAGE/CONCEPT/SOURCE/GRAPH/VERIFY T2 as substitute for actual index
binary extraction as implicit prerequisite for semantic navigation
blind 256-byte JSON truncation in carrier routing hint
BLACK=1 WHITE=0 as the main Rosetta semantic description
